bronze = (spark.readStream.format('eventhubs').options(**ehConf).load())

## Code Example

```python
from delta.tables import DeltaTable
# sample MERGE snippet demonstrating upsert
delta_table = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, "abfss://...@container.dfs.core.windows.net/tenant.delta")
src = spark.read.parquet("abfss://.../incoming/tenant/")

delta_table.alias("t").merge(
  src.alias("s"),
  "t.id = s.id"
).whenMatchedUpdate(set={"t.value": "s.value"}).whenNotMatchedInsertAll().execute()
```
